identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate HLX43 in Subjects With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multi-center, Global Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Subjects With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to to explore the reasonable dosage and evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients with Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study is an open-label phase II clinical study to explore the reasonable dosage and evaluate the efficacy, safety and tolerability of HLX43 (Anti-PD-L1 ADC) in Patients with advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). In this study, eligible subjects will be randomized at 1:1 ratio, and the patients will be administered with HLX43 at different doses via intravenous infusion.

armGroups.label: HLX43 DOSE 1 (2.0 mg/kg)
armGroups.description: Patients with good tolerability and well controlled disease will receive the treatment once every 3 weeks (Q3W), Until disease progression, initiation of a new anti-tumor therapy, death, emergence of intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of informed consent (whichever occurs first)

armGroups.label: HLX43 DOSE 2 (2.5 mg/kg)
armGroups.description: Patients with good tolerability and well controlled disease will receive the treatment once every 3 weeks (Q3W), Until disease progression, initiation of a new anti-tumor therapy, death, emergence of intolerable toxicity, or withdrawal of informed consent (whichever occurs first)

interventions.name: HLX43 DOSE 1 (2.0 mg/kg)
interventions.description: Dose 1; 2.0 mg/kg; HLX43 is an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a novel high potency DNA topoisomerase I (topo I) inhibitor, with a drug-antibody-ratio (DAR) of 8.

interventions.name: HLX43 DOSE 2 (2.5 mg/kg)
interventions.description: Dose 2; 2.5 mg/kg; HLX43 is an anti-PD-L1 monoclonal antibody conjugated with a novel high potency DNA topoisomerase I (topo I) inhibitor, with a drug-antibody-ratio (DAR) of 8.
